references.text: The same context with exemptions from military service, including those who have built a new house or planted a vineyard
A newly married man shall be exempt from military service for one year to bring joy to his wife
The curse describes a man who is engaged to a woman, but another man lies with her - the same fear mentioned in Deut 20:7
Gideon sent home those who were afraid, following a similar principle of allowing certain men to return from war
In the parable of the great banquet, one man excuses himself because he has just gotten married
Paul discusses how a married man is concerned with worldly matters and how he can please his wife
